def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 1000
    coupon_rate = 0.05
    market_yield = 0.07
    years = 15

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    annual_coupon = face_value * coupon_rate
    bond_price = sum(
        annual_coupon / ((1 + market_yield) ** year)
        for year in range(1, years + 1)
    )
    bond_price += face_value / ((1 + market_yield) ** years)

    # Return the answer rounded to two decimal places
    return round(bond_price, 2)
